rows.translation_en:
The word oni covers all sorts of things:
some look like people or animals,
some like tools, others like wind or fire.
One theory says powerful feelings such as
sorrow, hatred, anger, and romantic passion
take form as oni... but exceptions abound.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
In practice, anything we don't understand
that harms people gets lumped together
and called an oni.
I don't sympathize with them at all,
but when you think about it, that's a wildly
arbitrary system made for human convenience...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
This curse prevents members of the %@ clan
from joining with other humans
and leaving descendants.
But Divine Union means we'll be all right!!
Besides, the gods and goddesses
are all such kind, wonderful people...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Well, quite a few of them were...
I think!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.
Intentional hesitant correction to the previous claim about deities.

rows.translation_en:
If the %@ bloodline dies out,
everything vanishes like a bubble.
But look at it the other way:
as long as you're alive,
there's always hope!! That's what it means.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
So you must never give up.
Let's believe in tomorrow
with all our hearts!

rows.translation_en:
Fight, fight, fight, and grow stronger.
Fight, fight, fight, and earn Offering Points.
Fight, fight, fight, and reclaim treasure and money.
Fight, fight, fight, and have children.
Fight, fight, fight, and invest in the town.
Basically, in other words, what I'm saying is...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight...
Give up and you've lost!!
It's the only way forward.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Members of the %@ clan grow at tremendous speed.
About a year and a half to two years
after birth, they face inevitable death.
This is the Curse of Short Life.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If Health is low, there is a small chance
of dying before even that short life is over.
Please be careful.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Defeat Shutendoji and lift the two
loathsome curses
placed on your clan.
It's a long road, but we'll be all right!!
With Itsuka by your side,
let's give it everything we've got!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.
Itsuka's name is retained in the encouragement to avoid changing the companion reference.

rows.translation_en:
At Divine Union, quite a few deities
cannot be chosen even if
you have enough Offering Points.
Many of them had the darkness in their hearts
exploited by Shutendoji,
who turned them into oni.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If you can return those deities to heaven,
they will surely help the %@ clan
fulfill its vow.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When you're moving through a dungeon or cave,
look at the eight blue flames
that show your remaining time. If one is red...
that's a Red Flame of Frenzy!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When that flame's turn comes, until it burns out,
the spinning oni treasure list
will be bursting with rare, valuable prizes!!
They're pouring out left and right!!
Roll up, roll up, and win big!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The battle experience each person earns
by defeating enemies
is called Victory Points.
When these reach a certain amount,
all their Spirit, Skill, and Body abilities rise.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Victory Points are divided equally among
the allies who took part in battle.
It's terribly dangerous, so I don't recommend it,
but if you want to grow stronger quickly,
you can set out with fewer people.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If three matching entries line up
on the spinning oni treasure list, Victory Points double.
And if they're ☆ symbols, you get triple!!
I don't know why it happens,
but it must be the gods rewarding
the %@ clan for all its hard work♪
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Deities turned into oni
are controlled by Shutendoji
through Crimson Collars.
So if you spot a Crimson Collar, in green text,
among the spinning oni treasures,
there's a deity among the enemies!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Taking away the Crimson Collar should
break the curse and restore the deity's senses...
It should, anyway.
But cautious Shutendoji seems to have
put a second lock on the curse,
with a different key for each deity.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Unless you meet the condition for that key,
the spinning spoils will almost certainly
never stop on the Crimson Collar...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When you touch an oni, before battle begins,
a list of items, scrolls, money,
and other prizes starts spinning.
Wherever it stops
is the set of spoils you stand to win
if you win this battle!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
White text means treasure you've already acquired.
Yellow means treasure you haven't acquired!!
Keep your eyes peeled.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
For some classes, standing in the back row
limits their attack range,
or even leaves them unable to attack...
But that doesn't mean everyone should
charge to the front like a wild boar from Tanba.
That won't solve everything.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
In other words, anyone low on HP
should step into the front row
only when it's necessary!!
While choosing an action,
press L! Press R to move back.
Got it?
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
An ally is one hit away from defeat!!
You're healthy, but you don't have
enough healing spells or items...
That's the perfect time to buy a little time
with Protect.
It takes courage, but it's easy!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Choose Defend, then select the dying ally.
You'll take enemy attacks meant for that ally
until your next action.
Meanwhile, have someone else defeat the enemy
or heal your wounded ally
and turn the battle around.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Front row: more damage from enemies.
Back row: less damage than the front.
That's the basic rule.
But put everyone in the back,
and it's the same as everyone being in front.
There's no point. Not even a tiny point!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.
The pointless hot-spring pun is adapted as a deliberately weak no-point joke.

rows.translation_en:
The usual approach is to put people with high HP
and Defense in front, and anyone low on HP
or fighting for the first time in back.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Survive today and you can face tomorrow.
If a battle feels dangerous,
choose Retreat without hesitation.
The person ordered to retreat will watch for an opening
and escape on their next action.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
You won't get a message saying,
"But the enemy blocked the way!"
So don't worry about that.
Now, two more things to remember!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Your entire party does not
run away at once.
Only the person you told to Retreat escapes.
And when you're fighting an oni boss
deep inside a cave or dungeon, Retreat
is unavailable. Steel yourselves.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Now and then, the emperor designates
a cave or dungeon, probably on a whim.
If you hunt oni and monsters there
during that month, the emperor will reward you
with money according to your accomplishments.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The reward must be paid by the end of that month.
So finish that month's hunt within one month
and make absolutely sure you return home.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Going out to slay oni and monsters
or enter the Shutendoji hunting party
selection tournament is called a Sortie.
Before a sortie, always use the Clan menu
to check your members' Health, equipment,
and supplies.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Twice a year, in March and August,
a tournament to select the official Shutendoji
hunting party is held in the palace gardens.
You can go and defeat Shuten
without entering, of course...
But those prizes are so tempting!!

rows.translation_en:
The August tournament is an open competition
for anyone confident in their abilities.
The March tournament is by invitation only:
masters whose skills have caught the emperor's eye.
An all-star tournament, you might say.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Defeat the enemy leader,
and however many enemies remain,
you've won for the time being!!
But if your leader can no longer fight,
you lose even if everyone else is perfectly healthy...
And you return home immediately.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Some cowardly enemies will certainly
target only your leader, so always
watch the leader's HP closely.
The victors are the heroes! Winners write history!
On the battlefield, remember that "underhanded
scoundrel" can be a compliment.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
No matter how much potential someone has,
their Skill and Body abilities
are nothing special at first. Please remember that.
Equipment can make up for
some physical weakness, but their Skill,
which protects against enemy spells, is pitiful...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Even a pathetic Akadama spell
that won't leave a scratch a month from now
can kill if it lands badly.
Find some easy punching bags
and help them grow with boring practice battles...
Otherwise...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Ignore their wishes and keep them in back,
defending the whole time. Potential is only worth
something once it's grown and blossomed.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
In the third month after your child arrives,
the long-awaited day comes:
they can finally join the fighting force!!
Just as you're excited about
their future, %$,
they must be excited too.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
While that excitement is still fresh,
let them make their first battle
something to remember!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
For two months after a child
arrives at the %@ house, they're in training.
They cannot join the fighting force.
These two months are an important time
for building basic strength and studying
the knowledge their class needs.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Choose a family member as a teacher
for one-on-one training. It works many times
better than studying alone!
And if someone who has mastered a secret art
teaches their own child of the same class,
that art will naturally be passed down too.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
There are eight Class Manuals,
one for each class.
Only after obtaining
the appropriate manual
can you choose that class.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If you find an oni carrying a manual
the %@ clan doesn't have, do your best
to bring it home.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
From either the front or back row,
a single sweep of a fan can knock down
every enemy in either enemy row!!
Their Skill develops well,
so they learn spells easily and resist enemy magic
beautifully!! But...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Their fans' Attack is disappointing,
and they're stuck with light armor. Oh dear.
It's a tough life!! But...
they're fun and cute,
so let's forgive them wholeheartedly!
My number-one recommended class!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.
Itsuka's self-reference is I; class recommendation kept emphatic.

rows.translation_en:
The Crusher's hammer boasts
by far the highest Attack of any weapon.
But because the hammer itself is so heavy,
quick attacks are a little difficult...
And they're rather hopeless with spells...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
But once you've seen
a Crusher's destructive power,
those drawbacks may not bother you at all... Maybe?
From the front row, Crushers
crush one enemy in the enemy front row.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Of course, they can wear heavy armor.
And their outfits are so stylish♪
My number-two recommended class!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They can fire arrows at enemies anywhere,
even from the back row.
A bow's Attack rivals a sword's.
Their only drawback is being limited
to slightly worrying medium armor.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
But as long as they stay in back,
there shouldn't be a problem... Right...?
I'm sure there won't be!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
There are up to eight classes, including
Swordsman, Naginata Wielder, and Spearman.
When a child arrives at the %@ house,
the clan head chooses their name and class.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Once chosen, a class
cannot be changed for that person's whole life.
Please choose carefully.
The clan's class balance, spare weapons and armor,
passing down secret arts, compatibility with potential...
There's so much to consider...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When in doubt, choose the parent's class!!
Or just go by their face
and make a bold decision!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Gunners can attack from either row,
and changing guns lets them switch freely
between single and multiple targets. A dream class!!
Put a Gunner with a spread-shot gun
in the front row, and they can blast
every enemy with a bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They can only wear light armor,
but when they can do this much,
you can't complain!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
This class fights with bare hands and feet.
Speed and sheer number of attacks are its strengths.
From the front row, they pound
one front-row enemy with punch after punch,
and attack distant enemies with flying kicks!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They're limited to medium armor,
but they dodge everything, so that's no problem!!
Their equipment is cheap too. A bargain!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
A handy class that sweeps the entire enemy front row
from the front, and can attack
one front-row enemy from the back.
They can even wear large armor,
so they adapt to all sorts of battles.
I think they're very useful.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
I hear your mother was renowned for her spells,
%$, but was also
a first-rate Naginata Wielder...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
From the front row, they pierce one front-row enemy
and one enemy behind that target.
From the back, they stab one front-row enemy.
Spears have quite high Attack,
and they can wear large armor.
Perhaps they're even more useful than Swordsmen?
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They stand in the front row and cut down
one enemy in the enemy front row.
Swords have extremely high Attack
and come in many varieties.
They can also wear heavy armor.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Swordsmen excel on offense
and defense. They're the backbone of a battle!!
I've heard that your father, %$,
was a swordsman
without equal...
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Well, it's hell, so I imagine it starts with
the River Sanzu, then pools of blood, forests of needles,
and all sorts of other things.
But I don't know anyone
who's gone there and come back,
so I can't really say.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.
Uncertainty about hell is Itsuka's, not an authoritative dungeon feature claim.

rows.translation_en:
...Anyway, now you've come this far,
give it everything you've got!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en: This dungeon appears only during the three summer months.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They say the souls of samurai defeated
by Shutendoji at Mount Oe gather here,
unable to pass on and with nowhere else to go...
Apparently, many of its oni and monsters
use nasty spells that wear you down gradually.
Never let your guard down.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Of the red, blue, yellow, and green torii,
only one color leads to the main sanctuary.
The connections change with the seasons,
which sounds complicated,
but it's easy once you know the rule!!
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
They say Inari Palace is haunted by the ghost
of a poor woman who was possessed by a fox
and turned into an oni.
Oni and monsters with high Earth and Fire
attributes seem somewhat more common here.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
This happened a very long time ago,
so I don't know all the details...
But the emperor's younger brother
was supposedly framed for a crime and killed.
...What an ugly story, isn't it!?
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
And here's something even more ridiculous:
to appease that very soul,
they built the Royal Requiem Tomb.
Its oni and monsters generally have high Earth
attributes, so spells don't work well on them.
...That leaves good old physical combat.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Legend says a god once descended here.
But whatever it used to be, it's now the oni stronghold
where our mortal enemy Shutendoji waits.
Mount Oe is open for only two months a year:
November and December.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Naturally, the oni and monsters living here
are far stronger than in other dungeons!!
...But more than that,
victory depends on arranging things
so the entire hunting party is in peak condition
during those two months.
rows.context: Itsuka's help encyclopedia, first 80 consecutive body entries. Full help index and adjacent body entries examined. Explanations address the clan head; family members remain gender-neutral unless explicit in source.
review_notes: Help paragraphs may intentionally continue in the next record; original row and line-break counts retained.

Intentional one-word qualification of the preceding claim.

rows.translation_en:
They say a troublesome cat monster
who loves arson more than three square meals
is hiding deep in the caves.
Until a few years ago, this cat woman
was actually a goddess of impeccable lineage,
a rare thing in heaven...
